title: The Gold Coins of Jehangir
subtitle: A Hundred-Year-Old Mansion’s Hidden Mystery
summary: Feluda, accompanied by his trusted companions, is summoned to a grand riverside estate with an enigmatic invitation—and strict instructions to conceal their identities. What secret lies behind the walls of Amaravati, and why are its guests being kept in the dark? Step into a world where every guest has something to hide and every conversation hints at danger.
